## Feature Description
A clear description of the feature you'd like.

## Use Case
Why do you need this feature? What problem does it solve? The plugin aims to cover everything about a Navien appliance that HomeKit can express well: a tile, a scene, an automation trigger, a spoken command. So it helps more to describe what you want to happen in the Home app or with Siri than to name an API endpoint.

## Proposed Solution
How do you think this could be implemented? If you know the NaviLink command involved, say so; see [docs/PROTOCOL.md](../../docs/PROTOCOL.md) for what is already mapped and [the roadmap](../../docs/README-DETAILED.md#roadmap) in case it is already planned.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions you've considered.
